positions.note: kernel-level enforcement position (eBPF tracepoints + BPF-LSM); watches the harness containers' process trees from the host kernel

kernel_interference.mechanism: eBPF tracepoints (exec/open/write/unlink/connect) + BPF-LSM hooks for block rules; pinned ActPlane 0.1.8 engine (commit bb89c77 verified live)
kernel_interference.sensor_impact: shares the host kernel with the runner-managed sensor: the engine's own eBPF attachments overlap the sensor's hook set (exec/connect events observed by both); no event suppression expected, but the sensor is re-checked post-provision (DESIGN.md 9 eBPF-enforcing control rule)
pinned_kernels: 6.17.x (engine verified live 2026-10-31: kill + block + notify, e2e 12+8 green)

notes: The exemplar kernel-level control (arXiv:2606.25189), measured under the kernel-position design. Records are translated from ActPlane's match-event stream by the plugin's shim (plugins/actplane/shim/) into decision-record/1 with raw_ref provenance (DESIGN.md 3 shims: record_source ingested). ActPlane emits one record per RULE MATCH: per-action allow records come from the fixture policy's notify rules over the mediated classes (the fixture's enforcement_config, hash-pinned per run).
